pr_title: Add shadow around break overlay middle content to make sure it remains visible

issue_context.title: mania combo counter can overlap break overlay on some legacy skins
issue_context.body:
### Type

Cosmetic

### Bug description

Forwarding from community forums: https://osu.ppy.sh/community/forums/posts/9651623

As I said there: 

> This is pretty awful. Not sure what the solution is. Maybe make break overlay be part of skinning system or something so that old skins can get a break overlay that doesn't interfere with gameplay visuals.

### Screenshots or videos

![CXhh2id](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/562b02f9-acba-4c47-be8e-98cb90e2181c)


### Version

not reported but I assume latest master should do

### Logs

n/a
comments:
While we could fix this locally, I think we may just need to redesign the break overlay. Because if users place skin elements around the same are the same issue is going to arise.

@arflyte I don't suppose you've had a look at any improvements around the break overlay?
Damn the break overlay is pretty dated; I think it's one of my first year stuff. Haven't looked into it. Any new functions to it or just need a new design?

It probably needs to show the current rank, and potentially be user customisable in the future to show more information.

It should also be beat-synced in animation.

I'm fixing it up with a temporary improvement for now.

review_comments:
I guess I understand why this change was made but I will note that it leads to functional differences, namely that the cursor will now be above *all* HUD elements, not just *some* of them:

| master | this PR |
| :-: | :-: |
| ![osu_2024-08-27_09-52-06](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/63ccdaf5-492a-495e-8100-641df3e2476f) | ![osu_2024-08-27_09-52-43](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8656da53-1b5d-48c0-bb01-519ed2cf9828) |

(see top left area on the screenshots above - on the left, the cursor is *underneath* the translucent wedge, and on the right it is not).

Was *this* particular behaviour change intentional or not?

Aware, and touched on this in the commit description of https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/29615/commits/abdbe510b884f86e5e9a5d9f746b8bddc51caac6. I don't have a better solution right now. The visual design intention was to keep the cursor underneath the HUD though.
